Every plant, in its place.

Learn how a houseplant tracker can organise names, locations, photographs and care notes.

In development. App availability, supported devices, translations and Premium purchasing await release verification.

How can I track my houseplants?

Start with a nickname, known species and location. Add pot and light notes that help you understand the conditions around that plant.

Personal notes stay personal

Your plant names and journal entries should remain exactly as you entered them. Interface localisation is separate from your own writing.

A collection that stays useful

FloraTend is designed to keep saved plant records available locally, without a required account. Offline and restart workflows are subject to release testing.
